# Harvard Journal of Law & Technology

> A premier academic journal publishing rigorous legal scholarship on the intersection of law and technology, including AI regulation, privacy, intellectual property, and digital economy issues.

JOLT is published by Harvard Law School and features peer-reviewed articles, student notes, and a digest covering emerging issues in technology law. The journal also hosts annual symposiums and welcomes submissions from legal scholars and practitioners.

## Key Topics

- Law and Technology
- Privacy Law
- Intellectual Property
- Patent Law
- Data Protection
- AI Regulation
- Web Technology
- Software Security
- Digital Economy
- Open Source Software
- Supply Chain Attacks
- Tort Liability
- Legal Analysis
- JOLT Digest

## About & Mission

- [Homepage](https://jolt.law.harvard.edu): Main entry point for Harvard Journal of Law & Technology (JOLT)
- [About Us](https://jolt.law.harvard.edu/about): JOLT mission, history, and subscription information
- [Getting Involved](https://jolt.law.harvard.edu/getting-involved): Information on student involvement, editorial roles, and volunteering opportunities

## Published Content & Archives

- [All Volumes](https://jolt.law.harvard.edu/volumes): Complete archive of all published volumes and issues of JOLT
- [Volume 39 (Fall 2025)](https://jolt.law.harvard.edu/volumes/volume-39): Recent articles on privacy, encryption, and technology regulation
- [JOLT Digest](https://jolt.law.harvard.edu/digest): Curated coverage of AI regulation, privacy law, and legal technology developments
- [Web 3.0 and Digital Economy Regulation](https://jolt.law.harvard.edu/digest/the-potential-impact-of-web-3-0-on-digital-economy-competition-and-regulation): JOLT Digest analysis of Web3 impact on digital economy competition and regulation
